Source: andmed.eesti.ee, collected on 4 October 2026 through the same interface its own website uses: all 8,515 published entries (8,468 datasets and 47 data services), each with its full list of access links, file names and file types. Access types are assigned by rules from those links, file names and declared formats. An audit opened 86 sampled links outside the statistics tables and map services: 76% matched their type, 9% were misfiled (the rules were then corrected), and 15% were broken. Entries we opened are marked “Checked” in Browse. All 1,141 entries outside the statistics tables and map services were then reviewed again by website, which corrected 100 more (mostly download pages and live data feeds that were filed as web pages). Statistics tables answer GET with their variables and POST with data (PxWeb API manual).
